angle.hook: the pixel-art tactical RPG Guild Saga: Vanished Worlds, in Early Access on PC since 2024, is coming to PS5 in May 2027
angle.why_now: the developer announced it on the PlayStation Blog on 13 Nov
angle.what_it_means_here: PS5 players in the Gulf get a turn-based tactical RPG; the PS5 price is not stated and the Steam version has no Arabic
angle.payoff: May 2027, exact date to come, price unannounced
